historical_reviews.deepseek: Six lines after Board Manufacturer cannot prove complete motherboard chassis/board/product areas or the Web UI match and may select the wrong record.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains full raw evidence, exact FRU locator, normalization and three-way comparison while prohibiting writes and log clearing.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Motherboard identity is a set of correlated fields, not a substring. Manufacturer, product, part, serial, asset and production metadata must belong to the same located FRU record; mixing fields from adjacent `fru print` sections can create a plausible but false identity.

original_test_intent: Read the exact motherboard FRU through IPMI and BMC Web UI and compare the complete normalized identity to the approved platform record without altering FRU or diagnostic state.
original_method: Verify the same-target motherboard FRU device/locator, capture complete protected `fru print` output and synchronized UI evidence, parse all relevant chassis/board/product areas with checksum/encoding status, normalize allowed formatting, compare against the approved BOM/FRU record and preserve raw evidence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the motherboard locator and authoritative record; an operator confirms the Web UI page and reviews exceptions and the final verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not filter before retaining raw output
Reject default or ambiguous FRU selection
Stop on checksum/encoding failure or UI/IPMI mismatch
Never write values to force agreement
Do not automatically retry malformed reads
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete IPMI and UI evidence
Parse record areas and validation status

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `fru print` is relevant but the grep truncation and command-line password make it incomplete and unsafe; it also omits UI and approved-record comparison.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the full protected read-only FRU query for the verified motherboard locator, retain raw output, capture synchronized Web UI data and compare complete normalized fields to the approved record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute estimates and read-only FRU intent remain; log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build one field ledger keyed by FRU device/area, with raw value, normalized value, UI value, approved value, validation status and explicit optionality.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces substring filtering with complete record identity and three-way evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Board Manufacturer alone cannot establish correct motherboard part, serial, asset, dates or record integrity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UI may hide fields or apply formatting; differences require documented normalization rather than silent acceptance.

project_override_considerations: The Project must publish the authoritative motherboard record and locator. Any FRU correction/write is outside this read-only case and requires separate recovery-governed approval.
expected_evidence: Exact target, motherboard locator and approved record
Complete redacted raw FRU output and parser version
Normalized IPMI/UI/approved-record comparison and exception list

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target motherboard FRU readability/correctness and Web UI parity. Missing locator and expected values are prerequisites, not competing scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Locator, authoritative record and normalization rules are normal owner inputs; execution blocks only if exact identity or protected read access cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents a grep-truncated manufacturer fragment from standing in for the complete motherboard identity and UI parity contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU output often contains several similarly named board and product areas. A nearby manufacturer line can belong to a different replaceable unit, and six-line context is not a stable record boundary. Device locator plus complete decoded areas and raw evidence are needed to preserve field provenance and detect checksum or encoding defects.
